name: DeleteDcdnIpaSpecificConfig

parameters.description_en: The accelerated domain name. Only one domain name can be specified.

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. Only one domain name can be specified
parameters.help_zh: 您的加速域名，仅支持单个域名设置

parameters.description_en: The configuration ID. Call [DescribeDcdnDomainConfigs](~~130625~~) to query the configuration ID.
